summary: Capital One Financial Corp filed an 8-K regarding a prospectus supplement for the resale of 10,345,906 shares of common stock issued as consideration for its acquisition of Brex Inc., which closed on April 7, 2026. Selling security holders may offer these shares. The filing serves to register shares for resale under an existing shelf registration. Capital One terminated the Discover acquisition in early 2026, but this Brex deal appears to be a separate, smaller transaction. No price, premium, or board recommendation is given. Watch for overhang from the potential resale of these shares.
